en-US.name: Treasure Village
en-US.summary: A voice-first treasure-hunt adventure for kids on Fire TV.
en-US.description: Treasure Village is a family, at-home treasure hunt. Explore a village on screen and solve a math problem, riddle, or movement challenge at each stop by speaking your answer into the Fire TV remote. Collect all six map pieces to find the treasure!

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development-stage skill for personal family use only. Not intended for certification or store submission.
